title: Non-uniqueness of weak solutions to the 3-D stationary MHD equations in Besov space with negative regularity index
summary: In this paper, we study the 3-D incompressible fractional stationary MHD equations on the torus $\mathbb{T}^3$. For fractional power indices $α_1,α_2 >0,$ we prove that there exist infinite non-trivial stationary singular solutions of 3-D fractional MHD equations via convex integration. In particular, this result shows the non-uniqueness of weak solutions to the 3-D stationary MHD equations in some sub-critical Besov spaces.
